subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

In the limelight

options.text: In a well lit up room

solution:
The correct answer is **'The centre of attraction'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'In the limelight' **is** 'The centre of attraction'.**
 
• **In the limelight: **the focus of public attention. (जनता का ध्यान)
 
 
• *Example: The shock win has thrust him** into the limelight.***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *The centre of attraction.*
